key_findings: Conditional deletion of miR-21 in DRG neurons prevented CCL2 upregulation and CCR2+ macrophage accumulation after nerve injury, shifting macrophages to a TGF-beta-pathway-active M2-like phenotype and attenuating allodynia.
Allodynia attenuation by miR-21 knockout was reversed by the TGF-betaR inhibitor SB431542.
